partner_result_applied.use: Exact cone-trace identity specialized to positive levels and converted by a straight-line ruling into an angular average of 2D-marginal X-rays.

additional_completed_premise.scope: Every isotropic two-dimensional linear projection of independent cap-one coordinates has density at most e.

new_result.abstract_statement: If every orthogonal 2D marginal of Y in R^3 has density <=K, then Y1^2+Y2^2-Y3^2 has density <=pi K/sqrt(2) on (0,infinity).
new_result.qform_statement: For every exact-rank-three (+,+,-) form with all nonzero eigenvalue magnitudes >=1 and arbitrary independent cap-one inputs, ||p_Q||_{Linf(0,infinity)} <= pi e/sqrt(2)<6.039. By negation, (+,-,-) has the same bound on (-infinity,0).
new_result.mechanism: One-sheet hyperboloids are ruled by straight lines; the partner cone trace becomes an angular average of line X-rays, and product provenance caps each X-ray through a 2D marginal. Gaussian mollification handles arbitrary density versions.

unresolved_implication: MINORITY TWO-SHEET PRODUCT TRACE: for (+,+,-), uniformly control negative levels using product provenance stronger than the bare X-ray norm; dual for (+,-,-). Extra spectrum remains a separate nonseparable debt.
next_step: Attack the minority two-sheet side with translation-uniform half-Riesz/parabolic null-chart smoothing or an aggregate shear/ridge decomposition, explicitly respecting QFORM-TWOSHEET-XRAY-ONLY-FALSE.
